timing_scope: Model and fixed fused/joint schemas prewarmed by the preregistered three-control gate. Response caches are empty and prefix cache resets before each cold arm. Real inference/cache overhead included; no first schema compilation claim.
failure_policy: Each cell attempted once; ordinary generation/execution failure retained and next independent cell attempted. Source/config/replay integrity failure stops globally. No repeat-until-success.
integrity_supervision: External scripts/watch_suite_integrity.py checks frozen source hashes and failure JSON error fields (including nested llm_diagnostic errors) every1second. It never scans generated response bodies. Baseline response ambiguity, identity/source errors and any replay failure require global stop; only the verified own runner/descendants may be terminated. Ordinary policy JSON/domain failures retain original once-only continuation rules.
